entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A nightmare-like planeswalker of unknown gender and origin who manipulates fear and dreams and consumes nightmares.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane of gods and believers that draws Ashiok.

entities.name: Phenax
entities.description: The god of lies and deceit who bargains with Ashiok.

entities.name: Iretis
entities.description: A Theran polis whose citizens the leonin annihilate.

entities.name: Kedarick
entities.description: The king of Iretis, advised by Ashiok posing as Udaen.

entities.name: Leonin
entities.description: The lion-folk who retaliate by destroying Iretis.

entities.name: The Returned
entities.description: The undead for whom Phenax plans another necropolis.

entities.name: Cacophony
entities.description: A newborn god created from disturbed dreams of the poleis, slain by Ephara.

entities.name: Ephara
entities.description: The goddess who quickly slays Cacophony.

entities.name: Dack Fayden
entities.description: A planeswalker who, with Ravos and the dead, ends Ashiok's Sleep curse.

entities.name: Ravos
entities.description: A character who helps Dack end Ashiok's Sleep curse.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A fallen planeswalker whose dreams Ashiok savors and who spears Ashiok with the Shadowspear.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Phyrexian ruler whom Ashiok tricks on New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Nightmarish invaders Ashiok learns of from Elspeth's mind.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian-ruled plane where Ashiok meddles with Mirrans' dreams.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: The plane that fell under a magical sleep, where Ashiok turns sleepers' nightmares on the awake.

entities.name: Eriette
entities.description: A witch and author of the sleep curse who allies with Ashiok and is later freed by Jace using Ashiok's image.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: A planeswalker who strikes Ashiok with an ice bolt at Castle Ardenvale.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A character who restrains Ashiok on Eldraine.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who uses Ashiok's image as a cover identity on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Maag Taranau
entities.description: A vault on Thunder Junction that Jace plans to raid.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: The plane that holds the vault Maag Taranau.

entities.name: Atha
entities.description: A Theran firemage with secondhand knowledge of Ashiok.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Bolas's invasion of Ravnica in which Ashiok was somehow involved.

entities.name: Shadowspear
entities.description: Elspeth's weapon that spears Ashiok.

events.summary: Ashiok comes to Theros drawn by the power of mortals' belief and the darker side of belief, nightmares.
events.quote: Ashiok came to Theros because of the strong power of devotion and belief of the plane's mortals

events.summary: Ashiok bargains with Phenax and seeks to incite war between Iretis and the leonin.
events.quote: they made a bargain with Phenax , the god of lies and deceit

events.summary: Posing as Udaen, Ashiok sends nightmare abominations to kill people at a peace meeting; the leonin annihilate Iretis, serving Phenax's plan, and Ashiok asks to be made invisible to the gods.
events.quote: The leonin retaliated by annihilating the Iretis' citizenry

events.summary: Ashiok's experiment of disturbing citizens' dreams creates the god Cacophony, whom Ephara quickly slays.
events.quote: The newborn god was quickly slain by Ephara

events.summary: Ashiok's nightmares spread, causing magic users to wake with no memory of what they did and be cast out as Ashiok gathers power.
events.quote: Ashiok gathered power for the grandest spell

events.summary: Ashiok plans a Sleep curse over all Theros but Dack, Ravos and the dead put an end to it.
events.quote: Dack, Ravos , and the dead put an end to Ashiok's Sleep curse.

events.summary: Ashiok savors Elspeth's twisted dreams and learns of the Phyrexians, then is speared by Elspeth's Shadowspear and planeswalks away.
events.quote: After being speared by Elspeth's Shadowspear , Ashiok planeswalked away

events.summary: On New Phyrexia Ashiok tricks Elesh Norn with a fake failed compleation; Norn attacks and Ashiok leaves behind an Elspeth figure in Norn's armor.
events.quote: making it appear as if her glistening oil failed to properly compleat a Mirran woman

events.summary: On sleeping Eldraine Ashiok turns sleepers' nightmares against the awake and allies with Eriette.
events.quote: They allied with the witch Eriette , one of the authors of the curse.

events.summary: At Castle Ardenvale Kellan restrains Ashiok and Will strikes them with an ice bolt, forcing them to planeswalk away.
events.quote: struck in the chest by an ice bolt from Will, forcing them to planeswalk to safety

events.summary: Jace uses Ashiok's image as a cover identity to recruit a raiding team for Maag Taranau, first freeing Eriette.
events.quote: The first use of this cover identity was to free Eriette from prison and recruit her.
